_about: Writable parameters for Candy Simply-Fi washers / washer-dryers, recovered statically from candy_simplify.apk (it.candy.simplyfi 3.14.1, versionCode 226). Every request goes to GET http://<appliance-ip>/http-write.json. See protocol.md for evidence and the encryption scheme.

wifible.applies_to: configured_appliances.connectivity == 'wifible' and type washer / washer_dryer (CandyApplianceFactory -> washer.axibianca.model.Washer / WasherDryer). Interface types: bianca, red_devil_*, RAPIDO*, XCARE*, HWASH300*, SMARTPRO*, HWASH700.

dual.applies_to: connectivity contains 'dual' (Wi-Fi + NFC 'DualTech'), type washer / washer_dryer (CandyWasherDualTech / CandyWasherDryerDualTech). Interface types such as 3D_DUAL, 4D.

_protocols.how_to_tell_which: The app learns connectivity/interface_type from the cloud appliance record (appliances.json: 'connectivity', 'interface_type'). Without the cloud, guess from the model or try a read: both use the same http-read.json. Treat as an open question (see protocol.md).

parameters.name: Write
parameters.note: Always the first token of the plaintext command string. wifible getParametersMap() (used only when encryption is off) omits it for start commands.

parameters.name: StSt

values.1: start (wifible sends 1 even for delayed start)

parameters.evidence: Command.Param.START("StSt"); StopCommand adds StSt=0; CandyWasherCommand '&StSt=1' when delay==0

parameters.name: PrNm
parameters.meaning: programme number = knob/selector position (programme parameter selector_position)
parameters.values: integer from the programme table (see programmes.json selector_position_PrNm). 0 = OFF.

parameters.name: PrCode
parameters.meaning: programme code (programme parameter pr_code); disambiguates programmes sharing one PrNm
parameters.values: integer from the programme table (programmes.json program_code_PrCode)

parameters.name: PrStr
parameters.meaning: programme name shown on the appliance display (localised to Lang)
parameters.values: text; certain characters replaced by StringsHelper.encodeForAppliance (e.g. '°' -> '%28', ',' -> '%2C', Greek/Cyrillic -> %80..%FF codes) when on the local network
parameters.confidence: high (meaning of display usage inferred, medium)

parameters.name: TmpTgt
parameters.values: programme-specific; 0..maximum_temperature (bundled tables use 20/30/40/60/90). Omitted on wifible when temperature is -1 (programme default 255 = not applicable).
parameters.dual_rule: dual sends TmpTgt only when it differs from the programme default, and then also TmpDf=<default>

parameters.name: TmpDf
parameters.meaning: programme default temperature, sent alongside TmpTgt

parameters.name: SLevTgt

values.0: not applicable (wifible sends 0 when level is 255)

parameters.notes: Programme default 9 means 'use minimum_soil_level'. App forces soil 2 when temperature is 90 and soil 1 (dual). Some programmes share a PrNm and differ only by soil level (e.g. Saving 14'/30'/44').
parameters.confidence: high for encoding; level names inferred from assisted-wash assets (BREVE=1), medium

parameters.name: SpdTgt
parameters.meaning: spin speed in hundreds of rpm
parameters.values: rpm/100, e.g. 4 = 400 rpm, 10 = 1000 rpm, 14 = 1400 rpm. Omitted on wifible when 255 (not applicable). 0 = no spin (inferred).
parameters.dual_rule: sent only when different from programme default, together with SpdDef=<default/100>

parameters.name: SpdDef
parameters.meaning: programme default spin/100 sent with SpdTgt

parameters.name: OptMsk1

bits.8: good night (quiet, pauses before final spin)

parameters.constraints: only bits allowed by the programme's available_options; rinse bits 16/32/64 are mutually exclusive (exclusion mask 112); zoom forces OptMsk1=0

bits.1: zoom (shortened cycle); only when programme available_options2 & 1

parameters.name: OptMsk
parameters.meaning: option bitmask (same bit meanings as OptMsk1; 128=aquaplus only on 3D/4D interfaces)
parameters.notes: App quirk: on interface 3d_dual with brand==1 an OptMsk of 16 is rewritten to 128 ('pinkRule').

parameters.name: DelVl
parameters.values: integer number of 30-minute steps, 0..48 (0 = start now). wifible: StSt=1&DelVl=n. dual: DelMd=1&DelVl=n replaces StSt=1. Stop of a delayed cycle sends DelVl=0 (wifible) / DelMd=0 (dual).
parameters.evidence: Command.Param.DELAY("DelVl"); AbMaterialTimePicker steps mDelay by 1 per 30 min (max 48); AbDelayStartFragment.saveEndExit adds offsetHours*2; CandyWasherCommand '&DelMd=1&DelVl=%@'
parameters.confidence: medium (unit inferred from picker; status DelVal is displayed as minutes, see protocol.md open questions)

parameters.name: Stm

values.5: steam on (programmes with steam=5 on/off toggle)

parameters.notes: Which values a programme accepts depends on its 'steam' parameter: 5 = on/off toggle, 4 = user picks 1/2/3, 1..3 = fixed, 255 = steam-only programme.

parameters.name: Dry
parameters.meaning: drying after wash (washer-dryers; plain washers always send 0)
parameters.notes: Programme 'dry' parameter: 0 = no drying allowed, 255 = user may pick, 1..9 = fixed value. Dry-only programmes default to Dry=1. Chatbot maps steam to 22 internally but then converts it to Stm (never sent as Dry).
parameters.evidence: Command.Param.DRY("Dry"); Program.BIANCA_DRY_LABEL_TO_VALUE_MAP; WasherDryer.supportsDry()=true; AIDryerType.getValue (extra=1, iron=2, wardrobe=3)

parameters.name: Option
parameters.meaning: drying level for DualTech washer-dryers (equivalent of Dry)
parameters.warning: Values 2 and 3 are SWAPPED compared with wifible 'Dry'. Evidence is consistent inside each code path; verify on your machine.
parameters.evidence: CandyWasherDTCommand: '&Option=' + dry only for CandyWasherDryerDualTech; CandyWasherDryerDualTech.dryWithValue label array and dryValuesWithKey (ARMADIO->'2', STIRO->'3')

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.values: per assets/language_mapping/languages.json, e.g. bianca: it=0, en=1, fr=2, nl=3, pt=4, es=5, de=6, ru=7 ...; app sends the washer's current Lang from status if supported, else English

parameters.name: ED
parameters.meaning: extra detergent dose (auto-dose models, interface name contains '_ad')

parameters.name: StartCheckUp
parameters.meaning: self check-up flag inside a start command (0 normally); standalone 'StartCheckUp=1' starts check-up on HWASH700

parameters.name: DispTestOn
parameters.meaning: always sent as 1 in start commands; purpose unknown (status has DisTestOn/DisTestRes for self check-up)

parameters.name: Pa
parameters.notes: wifible pause/resume is a standalone command (AxiPauseWasherCommand), not offered on BIANCA interfaces (Washer.supportsPause). dual only ever sends Pa=0 inside start commands; the app has no dual pause button.

parameters.name: Sel
parameters.meaning: always 0 in start commands; Sel=1 used in the 'reset' command after a finished cycle

parameters.name: RestartGN
parameters.meaning: resume after 'good night' pause (finish the cycle)

parameters.name: SetHard
parameters.values: 0..2 (enum ONE/TWO/THREE ordinal) or raw int from settings UI

parameters.name: NTW_MODE / SSID / PASSWORD / ENCRYPT_KEY
parameters.endpoint: http-config.json (pairing only, on the appliance's own access point 192.168.0.1)
parameters.meaning: Wi-Fi security mode, home SSID (spaces -> '$' on non-Bianca), password, and the new 16-char session key

names_from_the_brief_that_are_not_write_.Temp: status field (current temperature setting). Write uses TmpTgt.
names_from_the_brief_that_are_not_write_.SpinSp: status field (spin; value <100 means hundreds of rpm per CandyWasher.getSpinSpeed). Write uses SpdTgt.
names_from_the_brief_that_are_not_write_.Opt1..Opt9: status fields, one per option bit (Opt1 = bit 1 ... Opt8 = bit 128; Opt9+ = second mask). Write uses OptMsk1/OptMsk2 (wifible) or OptMsk (dual).
names_from_the_brief_that_are_not_write_.DelVal: status field. Write uses DelVl (and DelMd on dual).
names_from_the_brief_that_are_not_write_.DryT: status field (current dry type). Write uses Dry (wifible) or Option (dual).
names_from_the_brief_that_are_not_write_.DryLev: not used for washer-dryers at all; only in the tumble-dryer library com.candy.tdlibrary (DryerProgram, ApplianceStatus).
names_from_the_brief_that_are_not_write_.PrCode: IS a write parameter on wifible (and also a status field).

wifible_start.omit_rules: TmpTgt omitted if temperature==-1; SpdTgt omitted if 255; parameter order exactly as above
wifible_start.success: response body = HEX(XOR('{"response":"success"...}', key)); app then waits 3 s and polls http-read.json

wifible_pause.note: the literal 'encrypted=0&' prefix is inside the encrypted payload (AxiPauseWasherCommand.addFirstParam(ENCRYPTED,0)); unencrypted form is ?encrypted=0&Pa=1

wifible_stop.plaintext: Write=1&StSt=0&PrNm=<current PrNm from status>[&DelVl=0 if a delayed start is armed]

sequences.wifible_after_finish: ResetCheckupCommand 'Write=1&StSt=0&PrNm=11' is used after a check-up; finished cycles are acknowledged in the UI only

dual_start.dry_only_programme: CandyWasherCommand returns early after PrNm/StSt + '&OptMsk=' for a CandyWasherDryerProgram whose isDry() is true, then CandyWasherDTCommand appends '&Stm=..&Option=..&RecipeId=..&CheckUpState=0'

dual_reset_after_end.note: app bug: missing '&' before PrNm; sent when the user dismisses 'washing completed'
